Privacy information

Your information.Handled thoughtfully.

How this redesigned website handles enquiries and privacy preferences.

Contacting Camak

The quote form asks for your name, email address, location and cleaning needs. Your phone number is optional. Please only include the information needed to discuss your request.

How your enquiry works

This preview prepares your enquiry in your email app. It does not submit or save your enquiry on a server. You choose whether to send the message to Camak.

Privacy preferences

This redesign does not add analytics or advertising trackers. It stores your chosen privacy preferences in your browser. You can reopen the controls from the footer or clear your browser’s site data.

External services

WhatsApp, Google Maps and email links open external services with their own privacy practices. The hosting service may process technical access information to serve and secure the website.

Questions about your information

Contact info@camakservices.co.nz for Camak’s current business privacy policy or questions about information you have shared.

This page describes the redesign’s behaviour. Camak’s complete approved business privacy policy is needed before the replacement website goes live.
